Invasiveness and IPD contribution of each serotype, by vaccine

plot_vaccine_candidates.Rd

Illustrates which serotypes are in which vaccines, and their (1) child invasiveness and (2) contribution to pre-vaccine IPD. Shows why the candidates for the vaccine design are chosen.

Usage

plot_vaccine_candidates(
  compodat,
  vax_cols = c(PCV7 = "#440154", PCV13 = "#414487", PCV15 = "#2a788e", PCV20 = "#22a884",
    PCV23 = "#7ad151", NVT = "grey70")
)

Arguments

compodat

From vaccine_candidate_data().

vax_cols

Named colours per vaccine (and "NVT").

Value

A patchwork of two plots.
